王建新回到宿舍，把门关上，插好门闩。

他坐在书桌前，从空间里取出信纸和钢笔。铺开信纸，拧开笔帽，想了想，开始给家里写信。

“爸、妈、大哥、大嫂、二哥、小妹：

你们好。我在草原上一切都好，身体好，吃得好，睡得好，你们不用担心。

告诉你们一个好消息。前阵子边境上有敌人越境，我配合部队打了一仗，立了功。部队首长看我表现好，特招我入伍了。现在我已经是一名光荣的解放军战士了。

还有一个更好的消息。首长们准备推荐我去上大学，学医。如果能成，我就能提前回城了。到时候在北京上学，离家就近了。

你们不要再给我寄钱了。我现在有津贴，够花了。之前你们寄的钱我都攒着呢，回去还给你们。

我在草原上很想你们。想爸做的红烧肉，想妈包的饺子，想大哥开车的样子，想二哥憨厚的笑，想小妹叫我三哥。等回去了，咱们一家人好好吃顿团圆饭。

你们也要保重身体。爸的风湿病，天冷了多穿点。妈的胃病，别吃凉的硬的。大哥开车注意安全。二哥工作别太累。小妹要听话，好好学习。

等我回去。

儿子建新

一九七零年七月二十日”

写完了，他把信纸折好，装进信封。明天问一下最近的邮局在哪儿，就可以寄走了。

然后他从空间里取出一套银针。这套银针是从乌兰巴托收来的，上好的纯银针，长短粗细一应俱全，装在牛皮针包里。他把针包打开，看了看，针尖锋利，针身光滑，每一根都保养得很好。他把针包放进抽屉里，合上抽屉。

坐在床上，闭上眼睛，通过脑海里的中医知识，想了一下明天应该怎么治疗。

周副团长的弹片在右肺下叶，位置不算太深，但离支气管很近。西医开刀风险大，容易伤到气管。用中医的方法——针灸加内服中药——可以刺激肺部产生无菌性炎症，将弹片包裹、液化，再通过化痰作用将其转化为可咳出的黏液状物质。这种方法见效慢一些，但安全，没有创伤。

“针灸取穴：肺俞、尺泽、膻中。肺俞是肺的背俞穴，能调肺气；尺泽是肺经的合穴，能清肺热；膻中是气会，能理气化痰。配合内服化瘀排异汤，一周左右应该能把弹片排出来。”

王建新在心里把治疗方案过了一遍，觉得没问题。便脱了衣服，躺在床上，早早睡下了。

而周副团长他们这边，散场后并没有各自回去休息。张团长、李参谋长和三个副团长回到了张团长的办公室，门一关，几个人坐了下来。

王副团长第一个开口：“老张，那个小王同志，你了解多少？”

张团长从抽屉里拿出一份材料，放在桌上：“这是他的档案，你们看看。”

姚副团长拿起来翻了翻，念道：“王建新，男，十六岁，北京人，家庭成分工人。一九六九年三月下乡插队，分配到达茂旗希拉脑亥生产队。同年六月任巡边员。一九七零年四月因抓获六名越境武装分子，荣立个人三等功。同年七月因击毙、缉拿三十余名越境武装分子，并解救一名同志，荣立个人一等功。”

“一等功？”王副团长的嗓门大了起来，“这小子立了一等功？我当兵二十年，才立过一个二等功！”

“你急什么。”张团长摆了摆手，“材料上写得清清楚楚，他一个人，一支枪，干掉了二十多个，抓了六个活的，还跑了几十里地救了红旗哨点的老牧民。这个一等功，给得不亏。”

李参谋长点了点头：“战报我看过，情况属实。而且他用的是一支五六半，不是机枪，不是冲锋枪。能在夜间精准击中三十多个目标，枪法确实了得。”

周副团长一直没说话，坐在那里，端着茶缸子，慢慢地喝水。等大家都说完了，他才开口：“他会看病的事，你们核实过吗？”

张团长说：“调查过。他刚到生产队的时候，就给一个知青治过痢疾，用茶叶和大蒜，把人治好了。还给牧民治过腰疼，给羊接过生。生产队的苏和队长说他‘会一点医术’。后来还当过赤脚医生，公社卫生院专门培训过他。”

周副团长点了点头，淡淡地说：“明天让小王同志试一试吧。看了这么多地方，都没有好的办法，说不准小王同志有别的方法。即使看不了也无所谓，反正这么多年了，也习惯了。”

众人叹了口气。周副团长是战场上拼杀出来的猛将，现在被一个弹片困在办公室里，跑不能跑，跳不能跳，心里的苦，谁都知道。

Wang Jianxin returned to the dormitory, closed the door, and fastened the latch.

He sat at the desk and took out the letter paper and pen from the space.I spread out the letter paper, unscrewed the cap of my pen, thought about it, and started to write a letter home.

"Dad, mom, eldest brother, sister-in-law, second brother, little sister:

Hello.Everything is fine with me on the grassland. I am in good health, eating well and sleeping well. You don't have to worry.

Let me tell you some good news.A while ago, there were enemies crossing the border. I cooperated with the troops in a battle and made meritorious service.The commander of the army saw my good performance and specially recruited me to join the army.Now I am a glorious PLA soldier.

There's even better news.The leaders were ready to recommend me to go to university and study medicine.If it works, I can return to the city early.When the time comes to go to school in Beijing, I will be close to home.

Don't send me any more money.I have an allowance now, which is enough.I have saved all the money you sent before, and I will pay it back to you when I get back.

I miss you so much on the grassland.I miss the braised pork made by my dad, the dumplings made by my mom, I miss the way my eldest brother drives, I miss my second brother’s honest smile, and I miss my little sister calling me third brother.When we get back, our family will have a good reunion dinner.

You should also take care of yourself.Dad has rheumatism, so wear more clothes when the weather gets cold.Damn you have a stomach problem, don’t eat anything cold and hard.Brother, please drive safely.Second brother, don’t be too tired from work.My little sister needs to be obedient and study hard.

Wait until I get back.

Son Jianxin

July 20, 1970"

After he finished writing, he folded the letter paper and put it in an envelope.I'll ask where the nearest post office is tomorrow and I can send it away.

Then he took out a set of silver needles from the space.This set of silver needles was collected from Ulaanbaatar. It is a fine sterling silver needle that comes in all lengths and thicknesses and is packed in a cowhide needle bag.He opened the needle pack and took a look. The needle tips were sharp, the needle body was smooth, and each needle was well maintained.He put the bag of needles in the drawer and closed it.

I sat on the bed, closed my eyes, and thought about how to treat tomorrow through the knowledge of traditional Chinese medicine in my mind.

Deputy Commander Zhou's shrapnel was in the lower lobe of his right lung, not too deep, but very close to the bronchus.Western medicine surgery is risky and can easily injure the trachea.The method of traditional Chinese medicine - acupuncture plus oral administration of traditional Chinese medicine - can stimulate the lungs to produce aseptic inflammation, wrap and liquefy the shrapnel, and then convert it into a mucus-like substance that can be coughed up through the phlegm-reducing effect.This method is slower to work, but safe and non-invasive.

"Acupoint selection for acupuncture: Feishu, Chize, and Tanzhong. Feishu is the back-shu point of the lung, which can regulate lung qi; Chize is the joint point of the lung meridian, which can clear away heat from the lung; Tanzhong is the qi meeting, which can regulate qi and resolve phlegm. Combined with the oral administration of Huayu Paiyi Decoction, the shrapnel should be discharged in about a week."

Wang Jianxin went through the treatment plan in his mind and felt that there was no problem.Then he took off his clothes, lay on the bed, and went to sleep early.

As for Vice Captain Zhou, they did not go back to rest after the game.Captain Zhang, Chief of Staff Li and the three deputy captains returned to Captain Zhang's office. As soon as the door was closed, several people sat down.

Deputy Commander Wang was the first to speak: "Old Zhang, how much do you know about Comrade Xiao Wang?"

Captain Zhang took out a document from the drawer and placed it on the table: "This is his file. Take a look."

Deputy Captain Yao picked it up, flipped it over, and read: "Wang Jianxin, male, sixteen years old, from Beijing, family background is a worker. In March 1969, he went to the countryside to join the production team in Shilanao, Damao Banner. In June of the same year, he was appointed as a border patrol officer. In April 1970, he was awarded the third-class personal merit for capturing six cross-border militants. In July of the same year, he was awarded the first-class personal merit for killing and arresting more than 30 cross-border militants and rescuing a comrade."

"First-class merit?" Deputy Commander Wang's voice became louder, "This guy has achieved first-class merit? I have been a soldier for twenty years, and I have only achieved one second-class merit!"

"Why are you so anxious?" Captain Zhang waved his hand, "It is clearly written in the materials that he killed more than 20 people with one gun, captured six alive, and ran dozens of miles to save the old herdsmen at the Red Flag Outpost. This first-class merit is well deserved."

Chief of Staff Li nodded: "I've read the battle report, and it's true. And he used a 56-and-a-half, not a machine gun, not a submachine gun. He was able to accurately hit more than 30 targets at night. His marksmanship is really impressive."

Vice-leader Zhou remained silent, sitting there holding a teapot and drinking water slowly.After everyone had finished speaking, he spoke: "Have you verified that he can treat doctors?"

Captain Zhang said: "We have investigated. When he first joined the production team, he treated an educated youth from dysentery and cured the person with tea and garlic. He also treated herdsmen's back pain and delivered sheep. Captain Su He of the production team said that he 'knows a little bit of medical skills'. Later he also worked as a barefoot doctor, and the commune health center specially trained him."

Deputy leader Zhou nodded and said calmly: "Let Comrade Xiao Wang give it a try tomorrow. After looking at so many places, there is no good way. Maybe Comrade Xiao Wang has other methods. It doesn't matter even if he can't see it. Anyway, after so many years, I am used to it."

Everyone sighed.Deputy Commander Zhou is a fierce general who fought hard on the battlefield. Now he is trapped in the office by a piece of shrapnel. He can't run or jump. Everyone knows the pain in his heart.
